title: Why a 10% Pay‑It‑First Rule Beats Budgeting Every Time

scenes.text: What happens when you auto‑save 10% of every paycheck?
Saving just 10% of income can grow to double the net worth of a non‑savvier peer over 30 years, thanks to compounding.
The average employer 401(k) match is about 4.5% of salary, effectively giving you free money on each contribution.
Start with 10% and let your employer match boost it—watch your wealth snowball.
scenes.label: START 10% TODAY
scenes.sub: Add employer match for faster growth
scenes.query2: how to begin pay yourself first

scenes.text: Follow and your future rich self will thank you.

description: A quick look at why a simple 10% auto‑save rule outperforms complex budgets. Start building wealth today with one easy tweak. 👉 Follow for more bite‑size finance hacks.
